title: Embedding quantization profile runbook and cosine-regression detector
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Runbook and implementation ticket to add a robust quantization profile lifecycle for embedding models (INT8/FP16 targets) plus a production cosine-similarity regression detector ("Sentinel") that prevents quality regressions after model quantization, kernel changes, or runtime upgrades.
background: We have seen small-but-actionable embedding quality regressions after deploying new quantization kernels and optimized matmul schedules. Current checks rely on offline cosine sampling that is noisy across batches and does not tie to retrieval metrics. This work defines a reproducible calibration workflow, per-profile artifacts, and a live drift detector that integrates with Console alerting and rollout policies.
goals: Define canonical quantization profile artifact (qprofile) for embeddings including scale tables, per-layer bit-width hints, and representative stats
Implement end-to-end calibration workflow: offline sweep -> constrained re-quantize -> verification on anchor set
Ship Sentinel cosine-regression detector that runs nightly and on deploys, with quantitative thresholds and automated rollback hooks
Expose validation dashboards in Console and tie detector signals to rollout policies (canary failover to fp16)
success_metrics: <0.5% of deployment pushes trigger a false-positive rollback due to noisy checks
Detection precision >90% for meaningful retrieval degradation (recall@10 drop >= 1.5%)
Calibration end-to-end runtime for standard anchorset (10k vectors) < 45 minutes on a single calibration pod
Per-profile regression alerts triaged within SLA window (4 hours)
scope: Create qprofile artifact format, implement calibration jobs, create Sentinel drift detector, add Console dashboard panels and alerts, update rollout policies to include auto-fallback to an FP16 variant.
out_of_scope: Full per-customer automatic re-quantization without explicit sign-off; VPC-only on-prem installation packaging (separate Private deployment ticket).
technical_design: qprofile is a versioned JSON blob with: model_key, base_dtype_target (INT8|FP16), layer_summary(stats histograms as compressed buckets), scale_table hints, representative_input_hash, calibration_seed, and validation_anchor_signature. Calibration jobs will run two phases: (1) sweep across per-layer quantization parameters to minimize MSE on embeddings for the anchor set, (2) constrained binary search that preserves vector norm distribution. Sentinel will compute a set of metrics for each daily build and deploy: mean_cosine, median_cosine, 95p_cosine, l2_norm_shift, and recall@k on a small retrieval test. Decision rule: fail deployment if mean_cosine drop > 0.015 AND recall@10 drop >= 0.01, OR 95p_cosine drop > 0.03. Thresholds are tunable via Console feature flag.
calibration_workflow_steps: 1) Create representative anchor set (golden anchor) - 10k vectors sampled stratified by tenant + length bucket
2) Run offline profile sweep job (sweep configurations stored in /calibration/configs/) producing candidate qprofiles (artifact id: qprof-<hash>)
3) For top-N candidates run constrained re-quantize that preserves top-layer scales and computes validation metrics against anchor set
4) Select candidate that maximizes recall@10 subject to mean_cosine >= baseline_mean - 0.012
5) Sign qprofile with calibration_seed and store in artifact store with provenance links
6) Attach qprofile to model bundle and run pre-deploy Sentinel check in staging cluster
7) If Sentinel passes, schedule canary deploy with continuous monitoring; if fails, mark as blocked and emit PR link to re-calibrate
validation_plan: Anchor set validation: compute baseline metrics from float32 baseline and compare candidate embedding outputs via cosine and L2 distributions
Retrieval simulation: run offline recall@k with a canonical query set (1k queries) to estimate product impact
A/B canary: small traffic canary (0.5% traffic) with drift detector running every 10 minutes; compare production metrics against baseline and expected variance
Periodic re-run: incremental detector runs nightly with sliding window 7d and alerts on sustained drift
rollout_plan: Staging: apply qprofile to staging model bundles and run full Sentinel report
Canary: 0.5% traffic with auto-escalation rules (if minor drift but within tolerance, increase to 5% after 1h)
Global: full rollout with active blocking alert to rollback if Sentinel triggers during canary or first 30 minutes
Fallback: auto-fallback to fp16 variant if thresholds exceeded; record event in audit log and create follow-up calibration ticket
monitoring_and_alerting: Console panels: qprofile artifact view, cosine distribution heatmap, recall@k trendline
Sentinel alerts: P1 when mean_cosine drop exceeds configured threshold OR recall@10 drop >= configured threshold
Auto-annotation: attach calibration artifact, git commit, and PR links to the alert
SLO implications: tie to quality SLO and Page on-call if high-customer-impact flag is set
open_risks: Anchor set drift: if anchor set is not representative, Sentinel will under/over-report — mitigation: rotate anchors quarterly and maintain tenant strata
Noisy metrics for tiny tenants: per-tenant stats may be too noisy; mitigation: require minimum sample size or fall back to cross-tenant rolling baseline
Performance tradeoffs: INT8 kernels may introduce latency jitter for small sequences — coordinate with runtime team for scheduling windows
False positives: aggressive thresholds can cause unnecessary rollbacks; start conservative and tighten over three calibration cycles
